title: Battle of Crête-à-Pierrot
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Crête-à-Pierrot", at revision 1370437879, opens: "The Battle of Crête-à-Pierrot was a major battle of the Saint-Domingue expedition that took place between 2 March and 24 March 1802 as part of the expedition's efforts to retake the colony of Saint-Domingue from Toussaint Louverture's control." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3486058, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1802 major battle of the Haitian Revolution". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
